items.resolution: With 0 cards selected, the 🚩 回報 batch button is aria-disabled; pressing it shows the toast 「先點一下要回報的字，再按回報」 and sends no request; with exactly 1 card selected the dialog lists that one word.
items.probe: What is the result for empty, single-element, or null input?

items.resolution: Word identity for dedupe and grouping is the exact trimmed string (no normalization beyond trim); the optional note limit (500) is counted in Unicode code points (Array.from(str).length), so a 500-character Chinese note is accepted and 501 is rejected/truncated by maxlength.
items.probe: Whose definition of length/equality applies — bytes, code points, grapheme clusters, or normalized form?

items.resolution: The ×n count pill is shown only when a group has n ≥ 2 reports; groups with more than 20 originals get the 20rem scroll cap; the >500 layer notice appears when the layer holds 501+ entries and not at exactly 500.
items.probe: What happens exactly at each min/max/threshold — and one step either side?

items.resolution: Grouping key is (report type, word) — or (char, reading) for char reports — compared as exact strings; the same word reported for two different reasons yields two separate rows; feedback/ai-word-suggest items are never merged (UI-SPEC D-11).
items.probe: When two things are exactly equal or just touch, do they merge, collide, or separate?

items.resolution: No reports → the admin shows the empty-state copy from UI-SPEC §8; a filter matching nothing → the empty-filter copy; select-all on an empty filter selects 0 rows and the batch buttons stay disabled.
items.probe: What is the result for empty, single-element, or null input?

items.resolution: Group rows are ordered by their latest report time, newest first; ties broken by word string ascending (stable); originals inside a group are newest first.
items.probe: When elements compare equal, is output order specified and stable?

items.resolution: Report times are shown in the browser local time to the minute (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm); counts are exact integers from the grouped records (no rounding).
items.probe: Where can precision loss, overflow, or rounding/tie-breaking occur — and what is the exact contract (e.g. half-up vs half-to-even, ceil/floor/truncate)?

items.resolution: Applying is idempotent per source report: applying the same agreed report twice (double click, two tabs, retry after timeout) leaves exactly one layer entry; the apply button is disabled while its request is in flight; concurrent admin writes are last-writer-wins on the single KV document, documented as acceptable because the admin is a single user.
items.probe: If interrupted or run in parallel, what is guaranteed?

items.resolution: Reverting an id that is not (or no longer) in the layer returns a not-found result, leaves the layer unchanged, and the admin shows a plain-language message; a successful revert removes exactly that entry and returns its source reports to 已核准未套用.

If the write-back run is interrupted at any step (after commit, after push, during live polling), re-running it neither duplicates entries in data/*-overrides.json nor loses any layer entry; it clears only the ids it wrote and confirmed live, so corrections applied while it ran stay in the layer; two simultaneous runs are not supported and the script documents this.
items.probe: If interrupted or run in parallel, what is guaranteed?
